name: claude-usage-statusbar
description: Show Claude Code 5h / 7d usage in the VS Code status bar.

commands.title: Claude Usage: Set up statusLine bridge

claudeUsage.oauthToken.markdownDescription: Long-lived token from `claude setup-token`. Enables session-independent polling of your usage. Leave empty to show only data pushed by an active Claude Code session (the statusLine bridge).

claudeUsage.pollIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: How often (seconds) to poll the usage API when a token is set. The endpoint is aggressively rate-limited, so keep this high (≥1800 / 30 min recommended). Set to `0` to disable automatic polling and only refresh when you click the status-bar item.
